question: Что такое Sync vs async endpoints и как это работает?
answer: async only when dependency stack benefits
short_answer: FastAPI supports sync and async endpoints; async is useful when the dependency stack performs awaitable I/O.
junior_answer: FastAPI supports sync and async endpoints; async is useful when the dependency stack performs awaitable I/O. Async endpoints run on the event loop, while sync endpoints are normally dispatched through a thread pool so blocking work does not directly block the loop. Важное ограничение: Declaring `async def` does not make sync drivers non-blocking; use an async driver/client or deliberately offload work.
follow_up_question: Какая типичная ошибка связана с Sync vs async endpoints?
follow_up_answer: Calling `requests` or a sync DB driver inside async endpoint blocks the loop despite the async function declaration.
